resources.string: Keep workouts as GPX files in a GitHub repo
New workouts are saved as GPX files in the folder %1$s of a repo you choose, and workouts found there are imported on this device.

Weight, step length and app preferences are kept in fitness/settings.json. A change made here wins.
When you delete a workout here, Sync now removes its GPX from the repo. Git history keeps it.
